Name: AT - Snowcrows
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[size=3]Content pack for Alternative Textures.
[b]
Note 1:[/b] As the seasonal texture is restricted until winter, the scarecrows must be placed in winter for the texture variation to take place.

[b]Note 2: [/b]You can use the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket tool[/url] from the Alternative Textures framework to change existing scarecrows into snowpeople during [b]the winter[/b].

[b]Note 3:[/b] Scarecrows will revert back to their normal textures on off-winter seasons.

[/size]

Downloads.Description:
Requires Alternative Textures.

See mod page for usage details.

Manifest.Name: (AT) Snowcrows
Manifest.Description: Changes scarecrows and deluxe scarecrows into snowpeople using the Alternative Textures framework.
